meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: 把任务拆成分阶段实施计划:先检索相关文档和示例,列出每阶段要实现的内容、文档出处、验证清单和应避免的反模式。
howto.when: 当你要求规划一个功能、任务或多步实施时触发,尤其是准备用 do 执行之前。

say.text: 帮我规划一个用户登录功能,分阶段列出实施步骤。
say.note: 会先做文档调研再出计划。

say.text: 先查 API 文档,再给我一份带验证清单的开发计划。
say.note: 计划会注明文档来源和验证方式。

say.text: 规划把现有代码迁移到新版本,每阶段要能独立验证。
say.note: 每阶段都会带验证检查。

howto.what_en: Turns a request into a phased implementation plan: first searches relevant docs and examples, then lists per-phase tasks, doc references, verification checklists, and anti-patterns to avoid.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation, especially before running it with do.

say_en.text: Plan a user login feature in phases with implementation steps.
say_en.note: It will do doc discovery first then plan.

say_en.text: Check the API docs first, then give me a dev plan with verification checklist.
say_en.note: Plan will cite doc sources and verification.

say_en.text: Plan migrating existing code to the new version, each phase independently verifiable.
